body.name: Ordinary full-kernel source family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction:
For \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\), set
\[
 \mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}
 =\{Q[V\setminus B_i](\cdot;b):i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}
 =\{P_b(V\setminus B_i):i\in[t],\ b\in\mathfrak X_{B_i}\}.
\]
The collection \(\mathbf B\) is ordinary full-kernel identifying exactly when the ordinary single-world ID procedure accepts every intervention-assignment and outcome cell of \(Q[S_0]\) from this complete finite source family.  As ordinary observed-law preprocessing, any marginal and any conditional whose displayed denominator is positive may be formed from a supplied full kernel; this does not add a source law not determined by \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\).
